misses.counterfactual_theory: A linked record of the original forecast specification, issuance time, eligible evidence cutoff, and subsequent realized path would make it possible to assess forecast performance. The supplied settlement prices alone cannot show whether any prior forecast was wrong or whether this information would have changed a decision.
misses.decision_reference: No prior forecast specification, issuance time, or eligible evidence cutoff is linked to the supplied settlement records; the registry identifies this as EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE.
misses.decision_relevance: POST_CYCLE_LEARNING / DATA_GAP_ONLY: without forecast-to-outcome lineage, target-time prices do not establish what was forecast beforehand or demonstrate a decision failure.
misses.miss_description: The supplied records document confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but do not link them to an earlier forecast specification or its decision-time information cutoff. This supports an auditability gap only, not a demonstrated miss.
misses.missing_history_problem: Settlement target timestamps are adjudication times, not decision or source-observation timestamps. Frozen forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent.
misses.outcome_reference: FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records supplied for EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36, EXP-FC-ff583ea5594940a96f87, EXP-FC-ff8bbf351d863d4efd90, EXP-FC-ffc360fa8497bb8afbc9, EXP-FC-fff4dc8b1f4b1ccb2378, EXP-FC-fc1f8ca0a65f13adcb5b, EXP-FC-fa2e9a120e04ed120b0f, EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5, EXP-FC-f97337f921c
